items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: we played opposite the Savoy Sultans... with Razz Mitchell on drums, and Mike Kerr on bass... Al Cooper and the Savoy Sultans.

ctx.x: You know they had ... we played opposite the Savoy Sultans, which was a great jump band, you know? They had tempos that you could not compete with. Don't ever be on

the other bandstand when the Savoy Sultans and play their tempos. You either had to play something slower or faster. Because they had a groove that you just -- you know, there was nothing else like it, with Razz Mitchell on drums, and Mike Kerr on bass, and gee, it was just a beautiful band, just a beautiful band; Al Cooper and the Savoy Sultans.

But they played for one type of thing, and we played for another type, and we were so often asked to play something fast, you know? We got into the habit of playing things at a tempo that, you know, what they called the "Lindy Hop" tempo, and ...
